findings.issue_text: Fallback locales are loaded only during controller requests, while the translation accelerator loads only config.locale, causing background jobs and mailers to incorrectly return “translation missing” when site or English fallback locales have not been loaded; load fallback locales in the translation path itself.

goldens.comment: The @loaded_locales instance variable in translate_accelerator.rb is lazily initialized and accessed by multiple concurrent threads without synchronization.

Consider normalizing the input locale (e.g., to a symbol) when checking/loading here to avoid double-loading if the same locale is passed as a String vs Symbol (also applies to other locations in the PR).

adjudication_records.issue_text: Fallback locales are loaded only during controller requests, while the translation accelerator loads only config.locale, causing background jobs and mailers to incorrectly return “translation missing” when site or English fallback locales have not been loaded; load fallback locales in the translation path itself.

adjudication.rationale: The finding correctly identifies that `I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded!` is only called in `set_locale` within the ApplicationController (line 160), which only runs during HTTP requests. The `translate` method in translate_accelerator.rb only loads `config.locale` (line 64), not the fallback locales. Background jobs and mailers don't go through the controller, so fallback locales (site default and English) won't be loaded, potentially causing 'translation missing' errors when the primary locale lacks a translation but fallbacks have it.
